2) Scope: you asked for "remove entirely" but mentioned accepting an audit stub. Please confirm whether you want: 
   - Option A: Full deletion from telemetry + stub containing only "deletion performed by Redwood on <timestamp>" (recommended), or

3) Inventory: please confirm the exact message-id(s) if you have them; thread-msg-id=668a4f2b helps but exact message-ids speed the process.

Once we have the admin confirmation and final scope, we'll schedule the removal. Typical ETA after verification is 48-72 business hours; if legal needs to sign off it could be longer. Monica and I will coordinate the runbook steps and record changes in SUPPORT-9876.

Rafael Mendes
